title: Harden pending publish recovery, drain proof, and command ownership
summary: Implements verified findings from the pending publish, drain, parked output, manifest, carry-forward, and repair/reconcile review packet.
reason: Pending publish drain and recovery cross final output, manifest integrity, backend-owned launch, and proof-of-output boundaries. Wrong-destination movement, manifest corruption, and bypassing park/drain proof are treated as critical safety failures.
behavior_before: Invalid pending recovery scan results could raise NameError instead of returning a fail-closed command result; the pending drain button did not mirror the guard's disabled state; several Network page backend command posts used dynamic route variables outside the lifecycle command dispatcher; the drain-pending-pushes entrypoint logged only recovered and remaining queued counts instead of the durable drain summary counts.
behavior_after: Invalid recovery scan results return the documented fail-closed message; blocked drain guard state disables the visible drain button and exposes aria-disabled; non-lifecycle Network page command posts use documented literal backend routes while lifecycle commands remain backend-contract dispatched; drain-pending-pushes logs recovered, attempted, succeeded, already-published, failed, skipped, and remaining counts from the durable summary when present.
tests_added: ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-PendingPublishSafetyChecks.ps1: pending drain summary log helper static and runtime assertions
